player_prompt.intro:
We u Mchezaji {player_id} mu {num_rounds}-round ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kwa kila round, pota nambari kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Baada ya mapoto yote mawili, lengo ni (2/3)x(wastani wa mapoto yote mawili),
na mchezaji ambaye poto lake lina karibu na lengo anashinda round hiyo.
Tuma jibu lako kwa fomu '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomu yolakwika; chonde tumizani malingaliro anu ngati [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Chiyerekezo chiyenera kukhala pakati pa {min_guess} ndi {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mchezaji 0 anauza {guess0}; Mchezaji 1 anauza {guess1}. Choncho, chaguo la Target ndi: {target}.

outcome.draw: M'mbali zonse, maseŵerawo ndi opanda kanthu.
